create_health_servicer: create a HealthServicer instance to handle gRPC health check RPCs for service statuses
check_service_status: check the health status of a named gRPC service using the HealthServicer Check method
watch_service_health: watch for health status changes on a gRPC service using the HealthServicer Watch method
set_service_status: set the health status of a named service to SERVING or NOT_SERVING via HealthServicer set
enter_graceful_shutdown: enter graceful shutdown mode that sets all services to NOT_SERVING via HealthServicer
